checked_profile.summary: An outcomes-based option for eligible students approaching graduation without a cosigner.
checked_profile.scope: These facts apply to Ascent’s non-cosigned outcomes-based loan. Its credit-based loans have different limits and repayment choices. Rates and approval depend on the actual application.

facts.label: Academic eligibility
facts.text: The outcomes-based program requires a 3.0 or higher GPA and satisfactory academic progress. Applicants must be juniors or seniors enrolled full-time at an eligible institution, or at least half-time when within nine months of graduation. Other eligibility rules apply.

facts.label: Borrowing limit
facts.text: The outcomes-based maximum is $20,000, with a $200,000 aggregate limit. The minimum is $2,001, or $6,001 for applicants with a permanent Massachusetts address. These are different from the credit-based product limits.

facts.label: Repayment
facts.text: The outcomes-based loan offers 10- or 15-year terms with deferred repayment. Payments start up to nine months after graduation or leaving school.
